mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy expectations and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 3-year rolling mean, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy environment, which reduces discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 850 thousand units) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS > 420000 million dollars) signals broad-based economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 420000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary easing, which reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening economic activity, which typically leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates economic weakness, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above its 3-year rolling median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and GDP growth (GDPC1) is weak (below 15700 billion dollars), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns due to deteriorating economic fundamentals over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 15700, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong housing market regime (HOUST > 900 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to have positive forward returns due to increased consumer spending and business investment, leading to higher corporate earnings over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.
